# nuclock_seat (Data Source)

The seat a person holds on a project, open or closed. Its rates are not read.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The project.
- `user_id` (String) The person.

### Read-Only

- `closed` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `position` (String)
- `work_format` (String)
